verdict.rationale: A public online filing portal could plausibly publish an llms.txt file or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows the Guichet unique offers either: its documentation is human-oriented French guidance on formalities, payment, signatures and tracking. The probes concern other state hosts (the Annuaire des Entreprises robots.txt and the recherche-entreprises API), not agent docs from this product, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
